hypothesis: Cryptocurrencies that underperformed over horizons longer than one month outperform recent winners over the subsequent week.
mechanism: Crypto momentum transitions into reversal after roughly one month; overreaction and limits to arbitrage cause past losers to rebound relative to past winners.
signal: Negative trailing close-to-close return ending at the prior completed hour.
universe: Point-in-time assets with exact hourly history sufficient for formation plus top 80 percent by lagged trailing 30-day close*volume; minimum 8 assets.
rebalance: Weekly Monday 00:00 UTC; current-open execution using only prior-hour information.
construction: Equal-weight long bottom past-return quartile / short top past-return quartile, 0.5 gross per side.
development_gate: Canonical mean rank IC >= 0.02, HAC p < 0.05, positive loser-minus-winner subsequent-week return, at least 100 weekly observations.
limitations: Prepared broad panel contains 19 Binance USDT perpetuals rather than the thousands of coins studied in the source; funding is unavailable in this OHLCV panel.
